versions.changelog:
Initial release of UI/UX Pro Max skill.

- Provides a comprehensive design guide covering 50+ styles, 97 color palettes, 57 font pairings, and 99 UX guidelines across 9 tech stacks.
- Features a priority-based, searchable UX rule database for web and mobile UI/UX.
- Supplies command-line workflows for analyzing requirements and generating design systems with anti-patterns to avoid.
- Supports persistent, hierarchical design system overrides at the page/project level.
- Includes best practice search for style, charts, typography, accessibility, and more, with stack-specific implementation tips.
